query:
SELECT id, student_name, student_email, student_phone, program_type, scheduled_at, time_slot, status, notes
FROM bookings
WHERE DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(scheduled_at / 1000)) = CURDATE()
ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC;
